name: engineering-standards
description: Apply the Home Projects Engineering Standards. 'engineering-standards-advise' checks a spec's technology decisions against the standards and records them. 'engineering-standards-scaffold' initialises an empty or docs-only repo to the standards — .nyx.yml, tooling, CI, deploy config, docs and a walking skeleton — and commits locally. 'engineering-standards-classify' records a repo's type, deployment target and database in .nyx.yml. 'engineering-standards-assess' scores every applicable criterion and writes docs/assessment.md with category scores, maturity level, blocking gates and actions.
